note: Data exported from existing processed CSV files. No live sensor data required.

files.description: Window-level sensor data with health, anomaly, and maintenance recommendations

columns.name: vibration_rms
columns.note: Derived from Ax, Ay, Az acceleration data

columns.name: health_score
columns.calculation: Based on deviation from normal baseline

columns.name: machine_status
columns.description: Condition state derived from health score

columns.name: anomaly_detected
columns.description: Isolation Forest anomaly flag (0 = normal, 1 = anomaly)

columns.name: anomaly_score
columns.description: Isolation Forest anomaly score (higher = more anomalous)

data_gaps: Temperature data: NOT AVAILABLE in original dataset
Humidity data: NOT AVAILABLE in original dataset
Data is window-level aggregated, not raw sensor readings

files.description: Electrical power measurements with printing stage labels

columns.name: power_factor
columns.description: Power factor (ratio of active to apparent power)

columns.name: printing_stage
columns.values: Integer labels (semantics defined in source dataset)

data_gaps: Electrical data is at higher temporal resolution than sensor windows
Cannot synchronize with sensor data - treat as separate context

limitations: Sensor data is window-level aggregated features, not raw time-series
Electrical and sensor data have different timestamps and cannot be synchronized
Temperature and humidity sensors are not present in the original dataset
Maintenance recommendations are rule-based, not ML-driven
No Remaining Useful Life (RUL) predictions included
Data is from historical recordings, not live ESP32 streaming
integration_notes: Place CSV files in Unity Assets/StreamingAssets/ folder
Use configurable interval for playback speed
Handle empty strings as missing values
